text:
elaine: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on Console/Optimize/API batching timelines — a few partners asked for concrete windows and what will be live in canary.

maria: Short answer: partner canary mid-June, GA planned late July. Canary scope intentionally narrow.

tom: Can we list exactly what is included? Partners want to test Optimize suggestions in the UI, batching knobs, and the new instrumentation tile.

maria: Canary includes: instrumentation dashboard (read-only), Optimize "quick-suggestions" API surfaced as a modal (no edits), and conservative batching defaults enabled but editable only via CLI (no UI controls yet).

kevin: Engineering detail: canary will expose generation + embeddings routes. Batching improvements (adaptive batching switch) will be behind a flag for internal + partner accounts only. No dedicated routing in this canary.

elaine: What acceptance metrics will we show partners? Keep it short.

maria: We'll publish: P50/P95 latency, peak qps, 5xx rate, and estimated token cost delta vs baseline. Also a pass/fail signal from automated evals.

sales-bot: draft blurb: "Console canary (mid-June): read-only Instrumentation dashboard, Optimize suggestions modal, updated batching defaults. GA: full Optimize panel + UI batching controls (late July)."

tom: Ops question: where does canary traffic land—Hosted or Dedicated? Need to schedule capacity.

kevin: Hosted for partner canary. We'll run a Dedicated smoke test in week after partner canary. If Dedicated looks stable, we'll add a small partner cohort.

elaine: Any migration risk for Optimize history DB or feature flags that could delay GA?

kevin: There's a tiny migration for recommendation metadata; it's backward-compatible. Everything behind feature flags so rollback is trivial. No blockers expected.

maria: Owners: Maria -> partner comms + blurb; Tom -> ops runbook + dashboard link by Friday; Kevin -> migration notes + pre-warm plan.

elaine: thank you — please reply here when runbook and blurb are posted. :rocket:
